# RunComfy AI Image Generation

💳 Paid API required — Curated by Skill Harbor — a smart model router for AI image generation on RunComfy: instead of picking a model yourself, the agent matches your intent to the right model in the catalog (FLUX 2 family, Google Nano Banana 2/Pro, OpenAI GPT Image 2, ByteDance Seedream/Dreamina, Alibaba Qwen Image and Wan 2-7) for both text-to-image and image editing, with each model's documented prompting patterns bundled in. By @genmedia-labs, listed here with credit to its creator. Requires the `runcomfy` CLI and a RunComfy account with paid generation credits — generation is billed per call.
